meeting_scene: The team members sat around the conference table, exchanging quiet hellos as the meeting began. Priya spoke up first, her voice smooth and confident, "I wanted to touch base with everyone about our current project deadline. As you know, it's coming up quickly, and I'd like to make sure we're all on the same page." Sam nodded in agreement, his eyes fixed intently on Priya, but his expression said nothing. Meanwhile, Jordan was scribbling notes on a pad of paper, his brow furrowed in concentration as he mentally ran through the tasks at hand.
